title: Burford contributes insights on fertilizer disputes to Corporate Counsel
summary: Burford contributes insights on fertilizer litigation to Corporate Counsel. Learn more.
body_markdown:
In an article for *Corporate Counsel* ,[Greg McPolin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/greg-mcpolin/) and[Christiane Deniger](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christiane-deniger/) examine how geopolitical tensions and market concentration are creating litigation and arbitration risks across global supply chains. Commenting on developments in the fertilizer industry, they examine the potential for force majeure, contractual and antitrust claims stemming from supply disruptions, rising costs and alleged anticompetitive conduct.


[Read the full article here](https://www.law.com/corpcounsel/2026/10/13/when-geopolitics-and-market-power-disrupt-supply-chains-legal-disputes-follow/) .
